title: Senior Product Manager, Checkout and Delivery Options
posting_text:
Lumen Cart's mobile app helps shoppers pick delivery windows at checkout.

What you'll do
- Own delivery-option selection in the consumer app
- Run A/B tests on conversion

What we're looking for
- 5+ years of product management for consumer app or e-commerce products
- Strong experimentation and growth-metrics track record

Nice to have
- Logistics or last-mile experience
company_text: Lumen Cart (fictional company for the sample data).
